text.aria-label: Title text 'Primary D12, scan-found, no NGED label (experiment 456): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-12 fit. Mean absolute error of the median forecast during the event, points of capacity: lagless 21.2, S1 14.7, B-mix 17.1, K2-S1 15.8. Orange band: K2-S1 90% interval. The event may be a load shift, a level change, or neither. Grey strip under the plot: lags inside a labelled event (empty for scan-found events, which have no label).'
text.tspan: Primary D12, scan-found, no NGED label (experiment 456): day-ahead forecasts (12 to 36 hours ahead), 2025-12 fit.
Mean absolute error of the median forecast during the event, points of capacity: lagless 21.2, S1 14.7, B-mix 17.1, K2-S1 15.8.
Orange band: K2-S1 90% interval. The event may be a load shift, a level change, or neither.
Grey strip under the plot: lags inside a labelled event (empty for scan-found events, which have no label).
